label: The head of the European Commission named as the head of the witches
description: Ursula von der Leyen identified by name as the head of the witches, talking directly to the devil, the head of the snake and the star at the centre of a pyramid of strands over Europe, said to be trying to bring a major world war over the continent.

label: The Antichrist system set up at Berlin, and the Pergamon altar
description: That Berlin is where they want to set up the Antichrist system, tied to CERN, to portals and to the devil himself over Europe, with the words Pergamon altar heard repeatedly.

label: MAGA is a red balloon on its last breath
description: The MAGA movement seen as a red balloon losing its air, fluttering at its last breath, with the Lord wanting to blow into it once more to give it a little longer in order to buy time concerning Europe.

label: A Democratic leader leaking Trump's plans to Zelenskyy
description: A leak and a mole inside the Democratic party, a Democratic leader passing Trump's plans to the Ukrainian president, with information taken off computers, alongside moles in the Pentagon.

label: Trump the lion tamer, wanting lavender over Russia
description: Trump seen as a lion tamer cracking a whip to defuse a war others want, seeking peace and what is called the breath of lavender over Russia and on the soil of Europe, against Macron and others trying to provoke a greater war. Lavender is never defined.

label: A triangle between Netanyahu, the Saudi crown prince and Europe
description: A three-way alignment seen between the Israeli prime minister, the Saudi crown prince and Europe, with instruction to watch what the crown prince does to connect it to the Middle East, and read as the route by which the Mahdi is raised through war.
aliases: connect this to the middle east

label: Zelenskyy fleeing with a hundred million in cash
description: A Jason Bourne type scene in which the Ukrainian president is seen snorting cocaine surrounded by prostitutes, with a hundred million dollars in hundred dollar bills loaded on a plane he means to flee with, given alongside his refusal of wartime elections.

label: Iran fizzles out and Europe is the bigger thing
description: That Iran is almost done and something major there will have an initial explosion and then fizzle out like a cork coming off a bottle, with the Lord saying attention should go to Europe because what is coming there is bigger, alongside a further round of shaking in Iran's leadership with Russia involved.
